explanations: There is none. The three variants look like copies that could drift, but the parts that matter are shared: proration lives in prorate() and all variants that prorate use it for both salary and pretax deductions; taxable income, bracket withholding and net are computed once in buildPayslip; rounding is centralized in roundCents. The only per-variant differences are deliberate (proration for partial periods, adding the leave payout to gross for final pay), so a change to tax or rounding rules applies everywhere at once.

Every variant returns buildPayslip(...), which is the only place applyBrackets is called with BRACKETS. Proration happens before buildPayslip and does not bypass it, and there is no per-variant withholding code to update.

The first 100_000 is taxed at 0.1 (10_000); the remaining 50_000 falls in the 100_000-400_000 bracket at 0.22 (11_000). Total 21_000. 15_000 applies 0.1 to everything, 33_000 applies 0.22 to everything, and 48_000 applies 0.32 to everything.

finalPayslip passes base + unusedLeavePayout as gross into buildPayslip, so it flows into taxable and withholding. pretax is prorate(e.pretaxDeductions, ...), independent of the payout, and the payout itself is not prorated.
